base.anonce: Landing page created for New Year's greetings from a group of companies.
base.description: Landing page created for New Year's greetings from a group of companies. The task was to create a landing page with autorun when a flash drive is connected to a USB port. Designed and completed the project.

ru.anonce: Лендинг, созданный для новогоднего поздравления от группы компаний.
